cards.text: Israel just rebelled against the house of David, and King Rehoboam, Solomon's son, escaped to Jerusalem in his chariot (2 Chronicles 10:18-19). Now he's home. I bet he's not taking this well.

cards.question: Rehoboam is back in Jerusalem after Israel rebelled. True or false: he gathers an army to fight Israel.

cards.text: He calls up 180,000 chosen warriors from Judah and Benjamin to fight Israel and get his kingdom back. That's not an army, friend, that's a whole stadium where EVERY seat brought a sword.
But before anybody marches, the word of the LORD comes to Shemaiah, the man of God. It's a message for Rehoboam and all the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin.

cards.question: Rehoboam and his 180,000 warriors are ready to go. What does the LORD's message tell them?

answers.text: Wait for a sign then attack

cards.question: The LORD's message to Rehoboam and the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin says each of them must return home. What reason does He give?

Rehoboam's army was set to go against Jeroboam son of Nebat, the man who came with all Israel to face Rehoboam (2 Chronicles 10:2-3). True or false: the army ignores the LORD's message and marches anyway.
Rehoboam lives in Jerusalem, and he builds up cities in Judah for ___.

cards.text: The list runs from Bethlehem to Hebron, fifteen fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin. He strengthens their fortifications and puts officers in every one, with supplies of food, oil and wine.

cards.question: Fifteen cities, each with officers and supplies. What else does Rehoboam put in all of them?

cards.text: He strengthens those cities greatly, and Judah and Benjamin belong to him. Walls up, shields stacked, this man double-locks EVERY door.
Rehoboam's cities are locked down tight. Then people start coming to him from all over Israel.

cards.question: From their districts all over Israel, a group comes to stand with Rehoboam. Who?
The Levites leave their pasturelands and possessions and go to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons ___ them as priests of the LORD.

cards.text: Jeroboam appoints his own priests for the high places and for the goat demons and calf idols he had made.

cards.question: The Levites aren't the only ones heading to Jerusalem. Who follows them there?

answers.text: People from every tribe seeking the LORD
Soldiers from every tribe seeking pay
Merchants from every tribe seeking trade

cards.question: True or false: the people who follow the Levites come to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

cards.text: All these newcomers strengthen the kingdom of Judah and support Rehoboam son of Solomon. Friend, most of us can't get ONE person to show up on moving day, and this man's got volunteers from EVERY tribe!

cards.question: The priests, Levites and others who came to Judah support Rehoboam for three years, because for three years they walk in the way of ___ and Solomon.

cards.text: Then comes Rehoboam's family: in all, eighteen wives, sixty concubines, twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters. The one he loves most is Maacah daughter of Absalom. EIGHTY-EIGHT children! I've got six cookie cutter kids, and Chip, my little gingerbread man, never let me get through one night without asking for one more story.

cards.question: Out of twenty-eight sons, Rehoboam names one chief prince among his brothers. Who gets the job?
True or false: Rehoboam makes Abijah chief prince but plans to give the throne to another son.

cards.text: Rehoboam also does something wise with some of his other sons.

cards.question: What wise move does Rehoboam make with some of his other sons?

answers.text: Spreads them through the fortified cities
Sends them off to serve Pharaoh

cards.text: He gives them abundant provisions and seeks many wives for them. Judah's strong and the family's set, but hold onto your apron, friend, because Rehoboam's story keeps going.
